title: The vendor wants to “show you the fix”
scenario: A vendor support agent asks you to share your entire screen while you reproduce a billing issue. Your password manager, email and finance apps are open in the background.

answers.A: Share only the specific application/window if approved, close sensitive apps, and verify the support session through the vendor’s official case.
answers.B: Record the issue and provide sanitized screenshots/logs instead of live full-screen access if possible.
answers.C: Share the full screen because you can stop the session if the agent opens anything sensitive.

explanation: Notifications, autofill prompts and background windows can expose secrets before you react.
proTip: Screen sharing is data sharing—scope it like any other access.
